# BAD-032 — Delete the orphaned trailer paragraph from the committing-and-pushing skill

## Brief
Eric declined BAD-030 (restore the Co-Authored-By trailer line): the Claude Code harness appends its own trailer to every commit, so the skill carries none. That leaves step 5 of .claude/skills/committing-and-pushing/SKILL.md with an orphaned paragraph (lines 34-38 at main 7594883): "This trailer overrides any other convention ... the history already carries three commits that leaked a model-versioned variant." No trailer precedes it, and the versioned trailer it calls a leak is now the rule. Eric (2026-09-14): delete the orphaned paragraph too. Keep the one rule in that paragraph that still holds, no Constraint: / Confidence: / Scope-risk: trailers, folded into step 5 so the step reads cleanly. Docs only; no other file changes.

## Size, persona and model decision
One writer on sonnet: a paragraph deletion in .claude/skills/committing-and-pushing/SKILL.md step 5, keeping the still-valid rule against Constraint/Confidence/Scope-risk trailers. Docs only; verification is proofreading the diff. Spud lands it by PR.
